## CheatReader v0.1.34

### Fixes
- Fixed closing quotes such as `」` being moved to a line of their own when "Prefer punctuation line breaks" is enabled (#29). A paragraph that fits on one line is no longer split, and wrapped lines no longer start with closing punctuation or end with opening punctuation.

### New
- Added a "Page overlap" setting in Reading Settings to choose how many lines from the previous page stay visible after a page turn, from 0 to 5 (#27). It applies to Page Up / Page Down, custom page shortcuts, and page-granularity automatic turning.

### Notes
- The page overlap defaults to 1 line, so existing page-turn behavior is unchanged until you adjust it. Set it to 0 to avoid repeating any line.
- Existing reader settings, bookshelf data, and reading progress continue to work as before.

### Verification
- All 90 Flutter tests pass, including new coverage for closing-punctuation wrapping and configurable page overlap.
- `flutter analyze` passes with no issues.
